_about: Story line gates for the screen probe (story levels 1-5). A gate says what the player must not have seen yet (unseen) or must be able to see (seen) when a caption whose text contains `line` (case-insensitive) is up, and which earlier lines must already have played (after: substrings of their text). Ids must match things[].id from window.R.snap(). Add a gate whenever a script line asks about or points at something, or answers an earlier line.

story-L001.why: The commander asks what the light is before the reactor can be seen.
The commander finds the reactor only after asking what the light is.
